_doc: 1. Backend running: cd int3_ai && docker compose up backend
with BRAIN_DEV_USER=priya (or any seed user id) in the backend env.
2. Gateway running: cd int3_ai && docker compose up gateway
with GATEWAY_AUTH=none (dev mode, no real OIDC).
3. MCP server built: npm run agent:build (produces agent/mcp/server.js).
The token value here ('dev') is accepted by the backend because
BRAIN_DEV_USER is set — any non-empty Bearer token maps to that user.
Gate 4 replaces this with a real OIDC token written at runtime.
